theorem Draft.isCommittedLogLb_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (l1 l2 : List
    Draft.LogEntry) : Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l1 ∗ Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l2 ⊢ ⌜l1 <+: l2 ∨ l2
    <+: l1⌝

theorem Draft.node.wp_readyRecv [package_sem : Assumptions] : Draft.node.readyRecv.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.Draft.node.readyRecv.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (n ch : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (st : Draft.NodeDriverState),
    st.handling = none →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          Draft.isReadyChan n γ N ch ∗ Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗ Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st -∗
            (▷
                ∀ rd,
                  (∃ ce es h L,
                      Draft.committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries' st.delivered.length ce ∗
                        Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗
                          (∃ rs,
                              readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' rs ∗
                                [∗list] s ∈ rs, Draft.readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗
                            Draft.readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ∗
                              Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                                (match L with
                                | none =>
                                  { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered ++ ce,
                                    hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, none) }
                                | some l =>
                                  { storage := st.storage, delivered := Draft.strip l.dlv,
                                    hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, some l) })) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal rd, intoVal true)) -∗
              WP ((chan.receive Ready.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

theorem Draft.deliveredLogLb_committed [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N
    : Namespace) (l : List Draft.LogEntry) : Draft.deliveredLogLb n γ N l ⊢ Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ
    l

theorem Draft.isCommittedLogLb_mono [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (l1 l2 : List
    Draft.LogEntry) : l1 <+: l2 → Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l2 ⊢ Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l1

theorem Draft.dynamicCluster_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (ps : List w64) (ctxs
    : List (List w8)) (boot : List Draft.LogEntry) (decode : Draft.ConfChangeDecoder) (transfer :
    Bool) (E : CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → Draft.BootLog ps ctxs boot → ps.Nodup → ps ≠
    [] → ¬W64 0 ∈ ps → ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 → ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs (Draft.LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)
    ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, Draft.ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ Draft.ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ Draft.readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 -
    2) ∗ Draft.isDynamicCluster γ N (Draft.Membership.simple (listToSet ps)) decode ∗ (if transfer =
    true then Draft.leaderTransferOn γ N else Draft.leaderTransferOff γ N) ∗ [∗list] id ∈ ps,
    Draft.nodeDynamicBoot γ N ps ctxs id

theorem Draft.leaderTransferOn_persistent (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) : Persistent
    (Draft.leaderTransferOn γ N)

theorem Draft.leaderTransferOff_persistent (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) : Persistent
    (Draft.leaderTransferOff γ N)

theorem Draft.readCredit_eq [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) : Draft.readCredit γ ⊣⊢
    Draft.readCredits γ 1

def Draft.LogEntry.isConfChange (e : Draft.LogEntry) : Prop :=
  e.type = W32 1 ∨ e.type = W32 2

    Draft.readCredits γ (a + b) ⊣⊢ Draft.readCredits γ a ∗ Draft.readCredits γ b

def Draft.StartNode.dynamicSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState) (hs : HardStateM)
    (csm : ConfStateM) (R : IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer) (ps : List w64)
    (ctxs : List (List w8)),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = [] →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            ps = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                              ps ≠ [] →
                                                ps.Nodup →
                                                  ¬W64 0 ∈ ps →
                                                    ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 →
                                                      cv.ID' ∈ ps →
                                                        σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                                          ⊢
                                                            ∀ Φ,
                                                              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                                  typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                                    isLogger lok ∗
                                                                      isStorage (GoInterface.ok si) ∗
                                                                        ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                                          (∀ Φ ss',
                                                                              ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                  { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                    ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                    scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                    sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                                    ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                        { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                          ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                          scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                          sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                      R -∗
                                                                                        hsOpt hp hs -∗
                                                                                          csPts cs DFrac.discard csm al -∗
                                                                                            Φ
                                                                                              ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs),
                                                                                                intoVal
                                                                                                  GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                                                                                  WP
                                                                                    ((intoVal
                                                                                        (methods si.ty
                                                                                          go!"InitialState"
                                                                                          si.v))
                                                                                      (intoVal ()))
                                                                                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                                            ownSlice peers pv dq ∗
                                                                              peersCtx pv ctxs ∗
                                                                                Draft.nodeDynamicBoot γ N ps ctxs cv.ID' ∗
                                                                                  storCap (GoInterface.ok si) 1 -∗
                                                                (▷
                                                                    ∀ nd,
                                                                      (R ∗
                                                                          ∃ n,
                                                                            ⌜nd =
                                                                                  interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType
                                                                                    (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                                              Draft.isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                                                Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                                                                                    (Draft.NodeDriverState.init
                                                                                      (GoInterface.ok si)) ∗
                                                                                  Draft.nodeConfig n γ N
                                                                                    { applied := 0,
                                                                                      membership :=
                                                                                        Draft.Membership.simple
                                                                                          (listToSet ps) }) -∗
                                                                        Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                                                  WP
                                                                    (((intoVal (functions StartNode [])) (intoVal c))
                                                                      (intoVal peers))

def Draft.node.readyRecv.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n ch : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (st : Draft.NodeDriverState),
    st.handling = none →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          Draft.isReadyChan n γ N ch ∗ Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗ Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st -∗
            (▷
                ∀ rd,
                  (∃ ce es h L,
                      Draft.committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries' st.delivered.length ce ∗
                        Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗
                          (∃ rs,
                              readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' rs ∗
                                [∗list] s ∈ rs, Draft.readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗
                            Draft.readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ∗
                              Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                                (match L with
                                | none =>
                                  { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered ++ ce,
                                    hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, none) }
                                | some l =>
                                  { storage := st.storage, delivered := Draft.strip l.dlv,
                                    hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, some l) })) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal rd, intoVal true)) -∗
              WP ((chan.receive Ready.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

theorem Draft.nodeDriver_deliveredLogLb [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N
    : Namespace) (st : Draft.NodeDriverState) : Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st ⊢ Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
    st ∗ Draft.deliveredLogLb n γ N st.delivered

theorem Draft.readCtx_commit [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (U :
    GSet (List w8)) (c : List w8) (Q : List Draft.LogEntry → IProp GF) : ¬c ∈ U → Draft.ownReadCtxs
    γ U ∗ □ AU <{ ∃∃ ops, Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅ <{ Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops,
    COMM □ Q ops }> ⊢ |==> (Draft.ownReadCtxs γ (insert c U) ∗ Draft.isReadCtx γ N c Q)

def Draft.node.Advance.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (snapOk : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop)
    (st : Draft.NodeDriverState) (es : List EntryM) (L : Option SnapLoan),
    st.handling = some (es, L) →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
              Draft.isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗ Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st ∗ advReceipt st.storage es L -∗
            ▷
                ((Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                      { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState, handling := none } ∗
                    match L with
                    | none => ∃ x, storFloor st.storage x ∗ ⌜↑st.delivered.length ≤ uint.Z x⌝
                    | some val => True) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Advance" (intoVal n)))
                  (intoVal ()))
                {{ Φ }}

theorem Draft.committedAtTerm_committed [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N :
    Namespace) (t c : w64) : Draft.committedAtTerm γ N t c ⊢ ∃ l, Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗
    ⌜l.length = uint.nat c⌝

theorem Draft.storageCertInv_persistent (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (γs : MemStorNames) :
    Persistent (Draft.storageCertInv γ N γs)

theorem Draft.Membership.applyChange_removeAbsent (vs : GSet w64) (cm : ConfChangeM) : cm.type = W32
    1 → cm.nodeId ≠ W64 0 → ¬cm.nodeId ∈ vs → (Draft.Membership.simple vs).Valid →
    Draft.Membership.applyChange (ConfChangeIM.v1 cm) (Draft.Membership.simple vs) = some
    (Draft.Membership.simple vs)

theorem Draft.cluster_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (ps : List w64) (ctxs : List
    (List w8)) (boot : List Draft.LogEntry) (snapOk : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop)
    (transfer : Bool) (E : CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → Draft.BootLog ps ctxs boot →
    ps.Nodup → ps ≠ [] → ¬W64 0 ∈ ps → ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs (Draft.LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)
    ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, Draft.ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ Draft.ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ Draft.readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 -
    2) ∗ Draft.isStaticCluster γ N ps snapOk ∗ (if transfer = true then Draft.leaderTransferOn γ N
    else Draft.leaderTransferOff γ N) ∗ [∗list] id ∈ ps, Draft.nodeBoot γ N ps ctxs id

theorem Draft.ownCommittedOps_get_lb [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (ops : List
    Draft.LogEntry) : Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops ⊢ Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops ∗ ∃ l,
    Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ ⌜Draft.opsOf l = ops⌝

def Draft.NoConfChangeIn (l : List Draft.LogEntry) (lo hi : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : Draft.LogEntry), lo ≤ k → k < hi → l[k]? = some e → ¬e.isConfChange

theorem Draft.isNode_persistent (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) :
    Persistent (Draft.isNode n γ N id)

theorem Draft.ownCommittedOps_timeless (γ : Draft.Cluster) (ops : List Draft.LogEntry) : Timeless
    (Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops)

theorem Draft.storageCertLink_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace)
    (st : Storage) : ((□ ∀ k E, ⌜↑N ⊆ E⌝ -∗ storCert st k ={E}=∗ Draft.snapshotCert γ N k) ∗ □ ∀ k
    E, ⌜↑N ⊆ E⌝ -∗ Draft.snapshotCert γ N k ={E}=∗ storCert st k) ⊢ Draft.storageCertLink γ N st

def (sealed) Draft.deliveredLogLb (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (l : List
    Draft.LogEntry) : IProp GF

def Draft.node.Advance.dynamicSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c0 : Draft.Membership) (decode : Draft.ConfChangeDecoder)
    (st : Draft.NodeDriverState) (es : List EntryM) (L : Option SnapLoan) (v : Draft.ConfigView),
    st.handling = some (es, L) →
      Draft.NoConfChangeIn st.delivered v.applied st.delivered.length →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                Draft.isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode ∗
                  Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st ∗ advReceipt st.storage es L ∗ Draft.nodeConfig n γ N v -∗
              ▷
                  ((Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                        { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState,
                          handling := none } ∗
                      Draft.nodeConfig n γ N v ∗
                        match L with
                        | none => ∃ x, storFloor st.storage x ∗ ⌜↑st.delivered.length ≤ uint.Z x⌝
                        | some val => True) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Advance" (intoVal n)))
                    (intoVal ()))
                  {{ Φ }}

    Draft.node.TransferLeadership.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.Draft.node.TransferLeadership.spec`, unfolded:

def Draft.readyRest (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (rd : Ready) (st :
    Draft.NodeDriverState) (ce : List Draft.LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) (L :
    Option SnapLoan) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms,
      entsRO rd.Entries' es ∗
        ownSlice rd.Messages' (List.map QMsg.loc ms) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ([∗list] q ∈ ms,
              iprop(msgOwn q.loc (readyDq q.st) q.st ∗ Draft.sentMsg γ N id q.st ∗ Draft.msgCredits γ N q.st)) ∗
            hsOpt rd.HardState' h ∗
              softStateRO rd.SoftState' ∗
                ⌜∃ Lx,
                      Lx < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                        (∀ (e0 : EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑es.length ≤ Lx + 1) ∧
                          ↑(st.delivered ++ ce).length ≤ Lx⌝ ∗
                  Draft.readySnap γ N rd st ce es L)

def Draft.node.ProposeConfChange.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (c : GoInterface) (o : ConfChangeIM) (dq : DFrac)
    (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
            Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗
              nodeCtx ctx cd ∗
                ownConfChangeI c dq (some o) ∗
                  AU <{ ∃∃ ops, Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅ <{ ∀∀ t bs,
                      ⌜MarshalsConfChange (some o) bs⌝ ∗
                        Draft.ownCommittedOps γ
                          (ops ++ [{ term := t, type := confChangeEntryType (some o), data := bs }]),
                      COMM True }> -∗
          (▷ ∀ err, ownConfChangeI c dq (some o) ∗ nodeErr cd err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              (((intoVal
                    (methods node.ty.PointerType
                      go!"ProposeConfChange"
                      (intoVal n)))
                  (intoVal (GoInterface.ok ctx)))
                (intoVal c))
              {{ Φ }}

def Draft.node.Propose.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (data_sl : GoSlice) (data : List w8) (ctx : GoInterfaceOk)
    (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)),

            Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗
              nodeCtx ctx cd ∗
                ownSlice data_sl data DFrac.discard ∗
                  AU <{ ∃∃ ops, Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅ <{ ∀∀ t,
                      Draft.ownCommittedOps γ (ops ++ [{ term := t, type := W32 0, data := data }]), COMM True }> -∗
          (▷
              ∀ err,
                ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ errStopped err ∨ errProposalDropped err ∨ ctxErr cd err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              (((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Propose" (intoVal n)))
                  (intoVal (GoInterface.ok ctx)))
                (intoVal data_sl))
              {{ Φ }}

def Draft.node.ApplyConfChange.dynamicSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (c0 : Draft.Membership) (decode : Draft.ConfChangeDecoder)
    (c : GoInterface) (o o' : ConfChangeIM) (l : List Draft.LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : Draft.LogEntry)
    (v : Draft.ConfigView) (m' : Draft.Membership),
    v.applied ≤ k →
      l[k]? = some e →
        e.isConfChange →
          Draft.NoConfChangeIn l v.applied k →
            decode (List.take k l) e = some o' →
              Draft.Membership.applyChange o' v.membership = some m' →
                Draft.Membership.applyChange o v.membership = some m' →
                  m'.autoLeave = false →
                    ⊢
                      ∀ Φ,
                        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                            Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗
                              Draft.isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode ∗
                                ownConfChangeI c DFrac.discard (some o) ∗
                                  Draft.nodeConfig n γ N v ∗ Draft.deliveredLogLb n γ N l -∗
                          (▷
                              ∀ csp cs,
                                csPts csp (DFrac.own 1) cs true ∗
                                    Draft.nodeConfig n γ N { applied := k + 1, membership := m' } ∗
                                      ⌜Draft.confStateIs cs m'⌝ -∗
                                  Φ (intoVal csp)) -∗
                            WP
                              ((intoVal
                                  (methods node.ty.PointerType
                                    go!"ApplyConfChange"
                                    (intoVal n)))
                                (intoVal c))
                              {{ Φ }}

    List Draft.LogEntry) : Draft.ownCommittedOps γ ops ∗ Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l ⊢ ⌜Draft.opsOf l
    <+: ops⌝

theorem Draft.wp_StartNode [package_sem : Assumptions] : Draft.StartNode.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.Draft.StartNode.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState) (hs : HardStateM)
    (csm : ConfStateM) (R : IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer) (ps : List w64)
    (ctxs : List (List w8)),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = [] →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            ps = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                              ps ≠ [] →
                                                ps.Nodup →
                                                  ¬W64 0 ∈ ps →
                                                    ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 →
                                                      cv.ID' ∈ ps →
                                                        σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                                          ⊢
                                                            ∀ Φ,
                                                              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                                  typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                                    isLogger lok ∗
                                                                      isStorage (GoInterface.ok si) ∗
                                                                        ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                                          (∀ Φ ss',
                                                                              ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                  { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                    ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                    scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                    sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                                    ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                        { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                          ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                          scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                          sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                      R -∗
                                                                                        hsOpt hp hs -∗
                                                                                          csPts cs DFrac.discard csm al -∗
                                                                                            Φ
                                                                                              ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs),
                                                                                                intoVal
                                                                                                  GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                                                                                  WP
                                                                                    ((intoVal
                                                                                        (methods si.ty
                                                                                          go!"InitialState"
                                                                                          si.v))
                                                                                      (intoVal ()))
                                                                                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                                            ownSlice peers pv dq ∗
                                                                              peersCtx pv ctxs ∗
                                                                                Draft.nodeBoot γ N ps ctxs cv.ID' ∗
                                                                                  Draft.storageCertLink γ N
                                                                                    (GoInterface.ok si) -∗
                                                                (▷
                                                                    ∀ nd,
                                                                      (R ∗
                                                                          ∃ n,
                                                                            ⌜nd =
                                                                                  interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType
                                                                                    (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                                              Draft.isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                                                Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                                                                                  (Draft.NodeDriverState.init
                                                                                    (GoInterface.ok si))) -∗
                                                                        Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                                                  WP
                                                                    (((intoVal (functions StartNode [])) (intoVal c))
                                                                      (intoVal peers))
                                                                    {{ Φ }}

theorem Draft.storageCert_register [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace)
    (γs : MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip) (E : CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E → ⊢ Draft.storageCertInv γ N γs -∗
    Draft.snapshotCert γ N k ={E}=∗ memStorCert γs k

theorem Draft.stepIn_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id :
    w64) (ml : Loc) (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) : (st.msg.Type' = MsgProp → st.ctx = []) →
    (st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgProp → NetMsgOk id { msg := st.msg, ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx :=
    st.ctx, resps := [] } ∧ st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgPreVote ∧ st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgTransferLeader) →
    (st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → ∃ sv, st.snap = some sv ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61) →
    st.msg.To' = id → Draft.sentMsg γ N src st ∗ msgPtsC ml (DFrac.own 1) (DFrac.own 1) true { msg
    := st.msg, ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx, resps := [] } ∗ Draft.msgCredits γ N
    st ∗ Draft.tickCredit γ (if st.msg.Type' = MsgTimeoutNow then 1 else 0) ⊢ |==> Draft.stepIn γ N
    id ml

theorem Draft.cluster_alloc_static [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64)
    (snapOk : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (E : CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs
    ≠ [] → vs.Nodup → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → ↑vs.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 → ⊢ |={E}=> ∃ γ, Draft.ownCommittedOps γ []
    ∗ Draft.ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ Draft.readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ Draft.isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk
    ∗ Draft.leaderTransferOn γ N ∗ [∗list] id ∈ vs, Draft.nodeRestartBoot γ N vs id

def Draft.RestartNode.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState)
    (hs : HardStateM) (csm : ConfStateM),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = vs →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            cv.ID' ∈ vs →
                                              σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                                ⊢
                                                  ∀ Φ,
                                                    isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                        typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                          isLogger lok ∗
                                                            isStorage (GoInterface.ok si) ∗
                                                              ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                                (□
                                                                    ∀ Φ ss',
                                                                      ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                          { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := ss',
                                                                            pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                            sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                        (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                            ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                  ss := ss', pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs,
                                                                                  sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                                                                                  fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                              hsOpt hp hs -∗
                                                                                csPts cs DFrac.discard csm al -∗
                                                                                  Φ
                                                                                    ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs),
                                                                                      intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                                                                          WP
                                                                            ((intoVal
                                                                                (methods si.ty
                                                                                  go!"InitialState"
                                                                                  si.v))
                                                                              (intoVal ()))
                                                                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                                  Draft.nodeRestartBoot γ N vs cv.ID' ∗
                                                                    Draft.storageCertLink γ N (GoInterface.ok si) -∗
                                                      (▷
                                                          ∀ nd,
                                                            (∃ n,
                                                                ⌜nd = interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                                  Draft.isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                                    Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                                                                      (Draft.NodeDriverState.init (GoInterface.ok si))) -∗
                                                              Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                                        WP ((intoVal (functions RestartNode [])) (intoVal c)) {{ Φ }}

    Namespace) (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) (sv sv' : SnapshotM) (c : w64) (E : CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E →

theorem Draft.node.wp_ApplyConfChange [package_sem : Assumptions] : Draft.node.ApplyConfChange.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.Draft.node.ApplyConfChange.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (vs : List w64)
    (snapOk : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (c : GoInterface) (o : ConfChangeIM),
    CCShrink (listToSet vs) (ccV2Of o).fst (ccV2Of o).snd →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
              Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗ Draft.isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗ ownConfChangeI c DFrac.discard (some o) -∗
            (▷
                ∀ csp cs,
                  csPts csp (DFrac.own 1) cs true ∗
                      ⌜cs.Voters'.Perm vs ∧
                          (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ cs.Learners' → ¬k ∈ vs) ∧
                            cs.VotersOutgoing' = [] ∧ cs.LearnersNext' = [] ∧ cs.AutoLeave' = false⌝ -∗
                    Φ (intoVal csp)) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods node.ty.PointerType
                      go!"ApplyConfChange"
                      (intoVal n)))
                  (intoVal c))
                {{ Φ }}

theorem Draft.readStateOk_used [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c :
    List w8) (idx : w64) (U : GSet (List w8)) : Draft.readStateOk γ N c idx ∗ Draft.ownReadCtxs γ U
    ⊢ ⌜c ∈ U⌝

theorem Draft.nodeDriver_hardStateCommitted [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Loc) (γ :
    Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c0 : Draft.Membership) (decode : Draft.ConfChangeDecoder) (st :
    Draft.NodeDriverState) : Draft.isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode ∗ Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st ⊢
    Draft.nodeDriver n γ N st ∗ (⌜st.hardState = hsZero⌝ ∨ Draft.committedAtTerm γ N
    st.hardState.Term' st.hardState.Commit' ∗ ⌜↑st.delivered.length ≤ uint.Z st.hardState.Commit'⌝)

theorem Draft.Membership.simple_valid (vs : GSet w64) : vs ≠ ∅ → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → GMap.size vs < 2 ^ 62
    → (Draft.Membership.simple vs).Valid

def Draft.node.ApplyConfChange.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (vs : List w64)
    (snapOk : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (c : GoInterface) (o : ConfChangeIM),
    CCShrink (listToSet vs) (ccV2Of o).fst (ccV2Of o).snd →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
              Draft.isNode n γ N id ∗ Draft.isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗ ownConfChangeI c DFrac.discard (some o) -∗
            (▷
                ∀ csp cs,
                  csPts csp (DFrac.own 1) cs true ∗
                      ⌜cs.Voters'.Perm vs ∧
                          (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ cs.Learners' → ¬k ∈ vs) ∧
                            cs.VotersOutgoing' = [] ∧ cs.LearnersNext' = [] ∧ cs.AutoLeave' = false⌝ -∗
                    Φ (intoVal csp)) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods node.ty.PointerType

theorem Draft.storageCert_read [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip) (E : CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E → ⊢ Draft.storageCertInv γ N γs -∗
    memStorCert γs k ={E}=∗ Draft.snapshotCert γ N k

def Draft.confStateIs (cs : ConfStateM) (m : Draft.Membership) : Prop :=
  cs.Voters'.Perm (elements m.voters) ∧
    cs.VotersOutgoing'.Perm (elements m.votersOutgoing) ∧
      cs.Learners'.Perm (elements m.learners) ∧
        cs.LearnersNext'.Perm (elements m.learnersNext) ∧ cs.AutoLeave' = m.autoLeave

def (sealed) Draft.ownReadCtxs (γ : Draft.Cluster) (U : GSet (List w8)) : IProp GF

def (sealed) Draft.storageCertInv (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF

def Draft.readySnap (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (rd : Ready) (st : Draft.NodeDriverState)
    (ce : List Draft.LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) : Option SnapLoan → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜rd.Snapshot' = null⌝ ∗ appendRight st.storage es)
  | some l =>
    iprop(⌜l.dlv = Draft.LogEntry.toEntries (Draft.strip l.dlv) 0 ∧
            l.ptr = rd.Snapshot' ∧
              ce = [] ∧
                st.delivered <+: Draft.strip l.dlv ∧
                  st.delivered.length < l.dlv.length ∧
                    l.dlv.length = uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                      0 < uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                        uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 ∧
                          uint.Z l.fl ≤ uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧ LogIndicesOk (snapId l.snap) es⌝ ∗
        ownSnapS l.ptr (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) l.snap ∗
          Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ (Draft.strip l.dlv) ∗
            Draft.snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ∗ readyOut st.storage es (some l))

theorem Draft.tickCredit_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (n : Nat) : ⧗n ⊢
    Draft.tickCredit γ n

theorem Draft.readStateOk_ctx [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c :
    List w8) (idx : w64) (Q : List Draft.LogEntry → IProp GF) (l' : List Draft.LogEntry) (E :
    CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E → uint.nat idx ≤ l'.length → ⊢ Draft.readStateOk γ N c idx -∗ Draft.isReadCtx γ
    N c Q -∗ Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l' ={E}=∗ ∃ l, ⌜l.length = uint.nat idx⌝ ∗
    Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ ▷ ▷ □ Q (Draft.opsOf l)

theorem Draft.sentMsg_persistent (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) :
    Persistent (Draft.sentMsg γ N src st)

def (sealed) Draft.storageCertLink (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (st : Storage) : IProp GF

theorem Draft.isStaticCluster_persistent (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (snapOk
    : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) : Persistent (Draft.isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk)

def Draft.StartNode.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState) (hs : HardStateM)
    (csm : ConfStateM) (R : IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer) (ps : List w64)
    (ctxs : List (List w8)),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = [] →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            ps = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                              ps ≠ [] →
                                                ps.Nodup →
                                                  ¬W64 0 ∈ ps →
                                                    ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 →
                                                      cv.ID' ∈ ps →
                                                        σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                                          ⊢
                                                            ∀ Φ,
                                                              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                                  typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                                    isLogger lok ∗
                                                                      isStorage (GoInterface.ok si) ∗
                                                                        ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                                          (∀ Φ ss',
                                                                              ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                  { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                    ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                    scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                    sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                                    ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                        { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                          ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                          scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                          sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                      R -∗
                                                                                        hsOpt hp hs -∗
                                                                                          csPts cs DFrac.discard csm al -∗
                                                                                            Φ
                                                                                              ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs),
                                                                                                intoVal
                                                                                                  GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                                                                                  WP
                                                                                    ((intoVal
                                                                                        (methods si.ty
                                                                                          go!"InitialState"
                                                                                          si.v))
                                                                                      (intoVal ()))
                                                                                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                                            ownSlice peers pv dq ∗
                                                                              peersCtx pv ctxs ∗
                                                                                Draft.nodeBoot γ N ps ctxs cv.ID' ∗
                                                                                  Draft.storageCertLink γ N
                                                                                    (GoInterface.ok si) -∗
                                                                (▷
                                                                    ∀ nd,
                                                                      (R ∗
                                                                          ∃ n,
                                                                            ⌜nd =
                                                                                  interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType
                                                                                    (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                                              Draft.isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                                                Draft.nodeDriver n γ N
                                                                                  (Draft.NodeDriverState.init
                                                                                    (GoInterface.ok si))) -∗
                                                                        Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                                                  WP
                                                                    (((intoVal (functions StartNode [])) (intoVal c))
                                                                      (intoVal peers))
                                                                    {{ Φ }}

    Namespace) (c0 : Draft.Membership) (decode : Draft.ConfChangeDecoder) (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) :

theorem Draft.snapshotCert_static [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace)
    (vs : List w64) (snapOk : List Draft.LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (l : List Draft.LogEntry) (i :
    w64) (d : List w8) : (∀ (t : w64), SnapListsOk { sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := {
    voters := vs, learners := [], outgoing := [], learnersNext := [] }, al := false, dat := d }) →
    l.length = uint.nat i → snapOk l d → Draft.isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗
    Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l ⊢ □ ∀ t, Draft.snapshotCert γ N { sid := { term' := t, index' := i },
    cl := { voters := vs, learners := [], outgoing := [], learnersNext := [] }, al := false, dat :=
    d }

    → (Draft.Membership.simple vs).Valid → Draft.Membership.applyChange (ConfChangeIM.v1 cm)
    (Draft.Membership.simple vs) = some (Draft.Membership.simple vs)

def Draft.Membership.simple (vs : GSet w64) : Draft.Membership :=
  { voters := vs, votersOutgoing := ∅, learners := ∅, learnersNext := ∅, autoLeave := false }

theorem Draft.deliveredLogLb_mono [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Loc) (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N :
    Namespace) (l1 l2 : List Draft.LogEntry) : l1 <+: l2 → Draft.deliveredLogLb n γ N l2 ⊢
    Draft.deliveredLogLb n γ N l1

def (sealed) Draft.leaderTransferOff (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) : IProp GF

theorem Draft.readySnap_dynamic [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Draft.Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c0
    : Draft.Membership) (decode : Draft.ConfChangeDecoder) (rd : Ready) (st : Draft.NodeDriverState)
    (ce : List Draft.LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (l : SnapLoan) : Draft.isDynamicCluster γ N c0
    decode ∗ Draft.readySnap γ N rd st ce es (some l) ⊢ False

theorem Draft.Membership.applyChange_valid (o : ConfChangeIM) (m m' : Draft.Membership) : m.Valid →
    Draft.Membership.applyChange o m = some m' → m'.Valid

theorem Draft.Membership.applyChange_removeVoter (vs : GSet w64) (cm : ConfChangeM) : cm.type = W32
    1 → cm.nodeId ≠ W64 0 → cm.nodeId ∈ vs → GMap.delete cm.nodeId vs ≠ ∅ → (Draft.Membership.simple
    vs).Valid → Draft.Membership.applyChange (ConfChangeIM.v1 cm) (Draft.Membership.simple vs) =
    some (Draft.Membership.simple (GMap.delete cm.nodeId vs))

    (Draft.isCommittedLogLb γ l)
